name: AI SEO Masterclass - Final Thoughts
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
A motivational wrap-up plus a 30-day action plan. Last updated in the source on February 12, 2026.

# 30-day plan (as written)
- **Week 1 foundation:** tools (Ahrefs, LocalRank, ChatGPT Plus, GSC, GA4), WordPress plugin stack, AI-crawler robots.txt, 20 "best X" keywords, first listicle published and indexed, monitoring set up.
- **Week 2 content velocity:** 2 more articles, syndication to Medium and LinkedIn, 10 PBN domains and 100 PBN posts.
- **Week 3 distribution:** guest post and outreach, Reddit commenting, first ChatGPT citation checks.
- **Week 4 optimize:** double down on what is working, full audit and month 2 plan.
- Claimed outcome by day 30: 5+ AI-optimized pieces, first AI citations and AI traffic.

# Mindset points
Start before you are ready, track everything, do not quit after two weeks.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- The tracking habit is the useful part: every TAG change should have a baseline and a re-check date (see [Documentation Screenshots](lib:brain-documentation-screenshots) and [SEO Tracker](lib:brain-seo-tracker)).
- PBN and Reddit steps in the plan are excluded for client work.

- [AI SEO Masterclass](lib:brain-ai-seo-masterclass), [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index), [Lesson Takeaways 2026-10-08](lib:brain-lesson-takeaways-2026-10-08)
